layout.heading: What Is a **White Label SMM Panel?**
layout.body:
A white label SMM panel is a fully functional social media marketing panel that operates under your brand identity instead of the provider's. Your clients visit your domain, see your logo, and place orders through your interface. They never see [SMMGen](/about-us) 's name anywhere in the process.

Behind your branded front end, SMMGen's infrastructure handles every order. Our delivery systems, provider connections, and backend processing power every service your clients buy. You own the customer relationship and the brand. We handle the technical work.

This model is also called a child panel in the SMM industry. The terminology describes the relationship: your branded panel (the child) sits on top of SMMGen's main panel (the parent) through an API connection. Every order placed on your panel routes automatically to our system for processing and delivery.

images.alt: What Is a White Label SMM Panel?

layout.heading: Why Build a **White Label SMM Business?**

cards.title: You Build Brand Equity, Not Just Income
cards.body: Every order your client places goes through your branded panel. They remember your brand name, not SMMGen's. As your client base grows, so does the equity in your brand. You can reinvest that reputation into new clients, new services, and higher pricing. A standard reseller sends clients to a panel that shows another company's branding. A white label owner builds something that belongs entirely to them.

icon.alt: You Build Brand Equity, Not Just Income

cards.title: Your Clients Self-Serve Around the Clock
cards.body: When clients can log into your panel and place their own orders at any time of day, your business generates revenue while you sleep. You do not have to be online, available, or responsive for every single order to process. The system handles it automatically. Standard resellers must be involved in every order. That limits how many clients they can serve and how fast they can scale.

icon.alt: Your Clients Self-Serve Around the Clock

cards.title: You Control Pricing Completely
cards.body: Your white label panel has your prices, not SMMGen's. You decide the markup on every service. You can run promotions, create service bundles, offer loyalty discounts, or price premium services at 5x the wholesale rate. Your white label panel displays your prices automatically inside a professional dashboard your clients trust.

cards.title: Your Business Grows With Client Accounts
cards.body: Every client who creates an account on your panel is a permanent addition to your customer base. They come back every time they need services because your panel is their established tool. White label creates lock-in through the professional experience and the existing client wallet balance.

icon.alt: Your Business Grows With Client Accounts

cards.title: Low Overhead, High Scalability
cards.body: Building a fully functional SMM panel from scratch requires backend development, server infrastructure, payment gateway integrations, API connections, security setup, and ongoing maintenance. The white label model gives you all of that at a fraction of the cost. SMMGen maintains the infrastructure. You pay for access and focus entirely on building your client base.

cards.title: Standard Reseller Panel
cards.body: With SMMGen's [SMM reseller panel](/smm-reseller-panel), you log into SMMGen's dashboard and place orders on behalf of your clients. Your clients do not have their own login. You manage orders manually or through the API. SMMGen's branding is visible on your side of the interface. This works perfectly for freelancers and smaller operations where you handle all client orders yourself.

cards.title: White Label SMM Panel
cards.body: With the white label model, your clients get their own branded dashboard at your domain. They log in, browse your service catalog, add funds, and place orders themselves. You are not involved in the individual order process at all. Your panel runs 24/7 without your manual input. This is the correct model for anyone building a proper SMM panel brand with its own customer base.

layout.heading: What Your White **Label Panel Includes**
layout.intro: When you launch a white label SMM panel powered by SMMGen, you get a complete, ready-to-operate business platform.

cards.title: Your Own Domain and Branding
cards.body: Your panel runs on your domain name. Your logo appears on every page. Your color scheme, your business name, your contact details. Clients experience your brand on every screen, from login to order confirmation.

cards.title: API Access for Further Automation
cards.body: If you want to take your panel further, SMMGen's API connects to your white label system for deeper automation. Resellers who want to build additional tools on top of their panel can do so using the API. Full documentation is on the [SMM panel API page](/smm-panel-api).

cards.title: Client Account Management
cards.body: Your clients register on your panel, create accounts, add funds, browse services, place orders, and track delivery. Everything happens inside your branded dashboard. You see all client accounts, order history, and balance activity from your admin view.

cards.title: Your Own Pricing on Every Service
cards.body: You set the price for every service in your catalog. Import the SMMGen wholesale rates and apply whatever markup you choose. You can price different tiers differently. Offer one price for standard services and a premium price for high-quality services. Adjust prices at any time without contacting us.

icon.alt: Your Own Pricing on Every Service

cards.title: Automatic Order Routing
cards.body: When a client places an order on your panel, the system routes it to SMMGen automatically through the API connection. No manual steps are needed from your side. Delivery begins within the same timeframe as direct SMMGen orders. Your client's dashboard shows the status updating in real time.

cards.title: Payment System for Your Clients
cards.body: Your panel includes a payment system through which your clients can add funds. You manage what payment methods you accept from your clients independently of how you fund your SMMGen account. Your client pays you. You maintain a funded balance on SMMGen to cover order costs.

cards.title: Full Access to SMMGen's Service Catalog
cards.body: Your panel connects to SMMGen's complete catalog of 9,000+ services across 15+ platforms. Every service available on SMMGen is available on your panel. Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Spotify, Discord, and more. Detailed descriptions for each platform are on the relevant service pages: [Instagram SMM panel](/instagram-smm-panel), [YouTube SMM panel](/youtube-smm-panel), [TikTok SMM panel](/tiktok-smm-panel), [Facebook SMM panel](/facebook-smm-panel), [Telegram SMM panel](/telegram-smm-panel), [Twitter/X SMM panel](/x-twitter-smm-panel).

layout.heading: How to Launch Your **White Label SMM Panel**
layout.intro: Step by step — from sign up to first client order.
layout.body: Contact our team at [smmgen.com/contact-us](/contact-us) for specific guidance on setting up your white label connection to SMMGen.

cards.title: Create a SMMGen Account
cards.body: Go to smmgen.com/signup and register. This gives you access to the full SMMGen dashboard, service catalog, and your API credentials. Your API key is the connection between your branded panel and our delivery system.

cards.title: Register Your Domain Name
cards.body: Choose a domain name for your branded panel. Pick something relevant to your brand or target market. Register it through any standard domain registrar. Keep it short and professional.

cards.title: Set Up Your Panel Software
cards.body: Your white label panel runs on [SMM panel](/) software. Connect the software to SMMGen using your API key. Import the SMMGen service catalog into your panel. The software handles the front-end interface and routes orders to SMMGen on the backend.

cards.title: Customize Your Branding
cards.body: Add your logo, set your color scheme, write your service descriptions, and configure your payment gateway for client deposits. Your panel should look completely like your own business.

cards.title: Set Your Pricing
cards.body: Go through every service category and set your retail prices. As a [Cheap SMM Panel](/cheap-smm-panel), SMMGen offers wholesale rates starting from just $0.0003, giving you plenty of room to stay competitive while maximizing your profits.

cards.title: Launch and Acquire Clients
cards.body: Your panel is ready. Promote your panel through social media, paid advertising, SEO, or direct outreach to businesses and creators in your target market. Every client who signs up is a recurring revenue source.

layout.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About **White Label SMM Panels**
layout.intro: Find answers to common questions about SMMGen, our services, and how the panel works.

faq.question: What is a white label SMM panel?
faq.answer: A white label SMM panel is a fully operational social media marketing panel that runs under your own brand name, domain, and logo. Your clients use your branded interface to place orders for followers, likes, views, and other social media services. The actual service delivery is handled by SMMGen on the backend. Your clients never see SMMGen's name.

faq.question: How is a white label panel different from a reseller panel?
faq.answer: A standard reseller logs into SMMGen's dashboard and places orders manually on behalf of clients. A white label panel owner has their own branded platform where clients log in and place orders themselves. White label is a full business product. Standard reselling is a manual fulfillment service.

faq.question: Can I use my own brand name and domain?
faq.answer: Yes. Your white label panel runs on your domain, shows your logo, displays your business name, and carries your brand identity on every page. Your clients have no visibility into SMMGen unless you choose to tell them.

faq.question: Do my clients know they are using SMMGen?
faq.answer: No. The white label model is designed specifically so your clients see only your brand. All order confirmations, dashboard screens, and service listings carry your branding. SMMGen operates invisibly as the backend provider.

faq.question: What is a child panel?
faq.answer: A child panel is another term for a white label SMM panel. The name describes the technical relationship: your branded panel (child) connects to SMMGen (the parent panel) through the API. Every order on your panel routes to SMMGen for delivery. The two terms refer to the same business model.

faq.question: How much does it cost to set up a white label SMM panel?
faq.answer: The cost depends on your domain registration, panel software, and any design work for your branding. Panel software varies but is generally affordable. Your SMMGen account has no setup fee. You fund your balance only when you start processing client orders. Contact us at smmgen.com/contact-us for a detailed setup conversation.

faq.question: Do I need technical skills to run a white label panel?
faq.answer: Basic familiarity with domain setup and panel software configuration is helpful. Most panel software is designed for non-developers. The SMMGen API connection is handled through your API key with standard setup steps. You do not need to write code or manage servers. Our support team at smmgen.com/contact-us assists with connection setup.

faq.question: Can I run a white label panel alongside the standard reseller model?
faq.answer: Yes. Some resellers use SMMGen's dashboard for their own manual orders while also operating a white label panel for a larger self-serve client base. Both models use the same SMMGen account and API credentials. Your balance funds orders from both systems.
